name: Install command types into the final lockup
looks: A dark terminal window types out a one-line install command, a small checkmark confirming it installed; the frame then settles on the product's mark and wordmark on a light ground, with the same install command repeated in a rounded pill beneath it and a small open-source credit line under that.
build: Terminal command clips in character by character, 30-40ms per character, confirmation checkmark popping in after; hard cut to the lockup card, mark+wordmark arriving together (`y:10px -> 0`, power2.out, ~350ms), the install pill and credit line fading in in turn beneath it.
sound: A quiet mechanical key-tick under the terminal line, a soft confirm tick on the checkmark, a low swell under the final lockup hold.
prompt: Type a one-line install command into a terminal window with a confirming checkmark, then cut to the product's closing lockup: mark and wordmark settling together, the same install command repeated in a pill underneath, and a small open-source credit line at the very bottom.
